common/common_rel#1.15152:
"HYPER MODE" SHADOW POKéMON, perhaps because
of their own overwhelming power,
may behave abnormally at times. They may engage in such behavior as
ignoring orders, even turning on
their own trainers in battle.
This, I have named HYPER MODE. On the plus side, HYPER MODE raises
the critical ratio of SHADOW RUSH.
However, HYPER MODE also prevents
the use of items on the POKéMON. HYPER MODE is easily dispelled.
Simply call the POKéMON by name.
However, this method has a major
drawback. Calling the SHADOW POKéMON's name
causes the closed door of its heart to
loosen and even open.
Further research is urgently needed. SHADOW POKéMON LAB
CHIEF EIN
common/common_rel#1.15155:
"EIN FILE S" is written on the FILE's
cover.

common/common_rel#1.15156:
"SHADOW POKéMON" A SHADOW POKéMON is a POKéMON that
has been made into a fighting machine
by artificially shutting the door to its
heart. What we didn't know is that the
SHADOW POKéMON exude a dark aura
that can't normally be seen by the
human eye. Unfortunately, a girl with the ability to
see this dark aura has been discovered.
This is a major problem. The girl could become a huge obstacle
for our SHADOW POKéMON PLAN.
A solution to this threat is urgently
needed. SHADOW POKéMON LAB
CHIEF EIN
common/common_rel#1.15157:
"EIN FILE P" is written on the FILE's
cover.
Read it?
common/common_rel#1.15158:
"Purification of POKéMON" SHADOW POKéMON are fighting
machines created by closing the door
to their hearts. The process of restoring a SHADOW
POKéMON back to its original state
is known as purification. Exactly how a SHADOW POKéMON is
purified is unclear, but there appear
to be several causes. We must eliminate reaction to these
factors, and create SHADOW POKéMON
that will never revert back to their
original, purified forms. SHADOW POKéMON LAB
CHIEF EIN
common/common_rel#1.15159:
"EIN FILE C" is written on the FILE's
cover.
Read it?
common/common_rel#1.15160:
"CELEBI's Power" The purification of SHADOW POKéMON
has several factors.
CELEBI appears to have the power
to boost the purification process. If a SHADOW POKéMON encounters
a CELEBI, it recalls how its heart was 
before being closed, and reverts to its
original form. The RELIC STONE of AGATE VILLAGE
also appears to have the power to
complete the purification process.
 These factors must be eliminated if our
SHADOW POKéMON PLAN is to succeed. SHADOW POKéMON LAB
CHIEF EIN

Authorities have made a stunning
announcement on the mysterious building
that exploded in ECLO CANYON.
It was TEAM SNAGEM's HIDEOUT. TEAM SNAGEM is a gang of POKéMON
abductors who have already been
marked for arrest. The HIDEOUT was discovered only as
a result of the explosion.
By the time police arrived, the ruined
building had already been abandoned. The cause of the explosion is under
investigation.
It should become apparent eventually.
common/common_rel#1.17007:
This is a repeat of an earlier
news story. A TEAM SNAGEM member was arrested
after being found hiding in ECLO
CANYON after the SNAGEM HIDEOUT
explosion. During interrogation, the SNAGEM
member revealed that the explosion
resulted from a clash between SNAGEM
members. The explosion apparently destroyed
the SNAG MACHINE used for stealing
POKéMON. However, it is said only the
large SNAG MACHINE was destroyed. The small, portable SNAG MACHINE
appears to have been taken by the
TEAM SNAGEM member who blew up
the SNAGEM HIDEOUT.

member, the smaller SNAG MACHINE
is compact enough to be carried by
a single person. Wearing this machine transforms
ordinary POKé BALLS into SNAG
BALLS. A SNAG BALL is an alarming device.

their trainers. It is hoped that the missing SNAGEM
MACHINE will not be used for criminal
purposes again.

You should work out with me and shed
a little sweat!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21145:
MAGRO: Whew!
I worked up a great sweat!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21239:
{speaker}: No light will illuminate your
path!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21244:
{speaker}: Light your own way with your
brilliance!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21265:
{speaker}: Listen up, young fellow!
POKéMON battling is about...
One, guts. Two, guts. Three and four,
guts. And five, guts!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21270:
YUDAN: Being too gutsy left me
tuckered out...
Gasp, gasp...
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21375:
{speaker}: How are you enjoying MT.
BATTLE?
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21377:
SOWA: Battles should be fun.
That's important!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21383:
{speaker}: AREA 5, the last in MT.
BATTLE's first half, ends here.
The closer is me, ZENTIN.
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21389:
ZENTIN: With AREA 6 starts the latter
half of MT. BATTLE.
Keep your drive alive. ZENTIN: Don't forget to pick up your
POKé COUPONS in the BREAK ROOM!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21401:
{speaker}: Oh, what a darling boy!
I will teach you in a way even you
will understand!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21406:
KINSON: You should teach me nicely
next time.
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21426:
{speaker}: I'm very good at this.
Big guy, please don't cry when you
lose.
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21428:
TOLI: You're a bad guy for picking on
a little kid like me!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21459:
Your win(s) in this AREA will
not be recorded.
Is that okay?
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21461:
AREA LEADER ZENTIN wants
to battle!
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21462:
{speaker}: You've got to be good to reach
AREA 5.
You should be proud of yourself. {speaker}: I'll check how well you've
raised your POKéMON.
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21466:
VOGI: I'll have to raise my POKéMON
some more, too.
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21518:
{speaker}: I have never lifted anything
heavier than a POKé BALL.
D2_magma_2/D2_magma_2.21521:
VESEY: Losing feels far heavier than
a POKé BALL, wouldn't you say?

D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21175:
{speaker}: Okay, big guy.
Are you all ready?
This is for keeps!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21177:
DAGA: This is the first time I've lost
when I played for keeps. DAGA: I promise I'll get tougher, so
let's battle again!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21225:
Your win(s) in this AREA will
not be recorded.
Is that okay?
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21229:
AREA LEADER LOKO wants
to battle!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21259:
{speaker}: Wow.
You beat my teacher LEINE.
That's pretty decent!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21264:
LATON: You're doing great.
Keep it up!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21280:
{speaker}: I'll show you the fruits of my
daily training!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21284:
HAKEN: Where did you do your
training?
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21298:
{speaker}: I'm a beautiful trainer.
My POKéMON are beautiful, too.
Want to see?
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21303:
FIAL: My makeup's been ruined by
perspiration.
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21489:
{speaker}: Hi, I'm LOKO.
You must be the high-energy trainer
I keep hearing about. LOKO: So, how about showing me that
high energy of yours?
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21491:
LOKO: What a fun battle that was!
Get your POKé COUPONS in the BREAK
ROOM!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21495:
{speaker}: Do you feel like training with
me?
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21514:
{speaker}: Oh, are you a new student?
Welcome to AREA 6! {speaker}: Let's begin with our battle
lesson!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21516:
LEINE: You're the type of student that
gets better through real battling rather
than from your studies.
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21522:
ILLA: You should pay heed to a lady's
request.
Such uncouth behavior!
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21535:
{speaker}: No challenger's come this high
in a while.
D2_magma_3/D2_magma_3.21539:
BODA: Thanks for showing me one
amusing battle.

D2_out/D2_out.21127:
{speaker}: Thinking about taking the MT.
BATTLE challenge?
Forget about it!
I'd keep clear of that place for now. {speaker}: I hear MT. BATTLE's been taken
over by a bunch of trainers that use
weird POKéMON.
D2_out/D2_out.21128:
{speaker}: Those trainers who'd taken over
MT. BATTLE went off running! {speaker}: What happened inside there,
I wonder?
D2_out/D2_out.21130:
{speaker}: There's this building that I guess is
a LAB; it's out in the middle of the
desert.
Did you know?
D2_out/D2_out.21132:
{speaker}: Maybe they're making those weird
POKéMON out there...
Nah, that can't be, huh?
D2_out/D2_out.21134:
{speaker}: I think it's worth a look.
There's this shady atmosphere about
it.
D2_out/D2_out.21499:
{speaker}: It's terrible, terrible!
I tell you, it's terrible!
Gasp, gasp... {speaker}: MT. BATTLE is under attack by
a group of shady people!
Gasp, gasp...
I'm so out of breath...
D2_out/D2_out.21501:
{speaker}: Huh?
You made the bad guys run off?
That's so hard to believe! {speaker}: I'm sorry, but I want to see
the proof with my own eyes!
D2_out/D2_out.21504:
AIDEL: You'd be able to protect the
world's peace, I bet!
D2_out/D2_out.21505:
{speaker}: Gasp, gasp...
MT. BATTLE is back to normal, so I'm
going to make the knockout
challenge. {speaker}: But before I do, I'm going
to warmup with you!
D2_out/D2_out.21507:
AIDEL: Running too much before battle
wasn't a good idea...
Gasp, gasp...

D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.15144:
{speaker}: Uh...
Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER. {speaker}: Don't be shocked, but...
I can make POKéMON forget their
moves. {speaker}: Would you like me to do that?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.15145:
{speaker}: Which POKéMON should forget
a move?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.15146:
{speaker}: All right.
Which move should be forgotten?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.15147:
{speaker}: Hm!
{32}'s
{39}? That move
should be forgotten?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.15148:
{speaker}: It worked to perfection!
{32} has forgotten
{39} completely. {speaker}: Are there any other moves to
be forgotten?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.15149:
{speaker}: Come again if there are other
moves to be forgotten.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.15150:
{speaker}: Hmmm...
I'm sorry to disappoint you, but
there's nothing that I can do for
this POKéMON. {speaker}: Would you like me to make
a different POKéMON forget a
move or two?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.17578:
{speaker}: {32} seems to
know only one move. {speaker}: Would you like me to make
a different POKéMON forget a
move or two?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21135:
{speaker}: A bunch of creepy-looking trainers
came and started attacking other
trainers without any warning! {speaker}: Those trainers...
The POKéMON they had weren't normal,
any way you look at them.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21137:
{speaker}: You two are amazing!
It's great that you saved VANDER
and got rewarded with the TIME
FLUTE. {speaker}: I've heard that you can summon
CELEBI with it at the RELIC FOREST.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21140:
{speaker}: It's great that MT. BATTLE's back
to being normal, but... {speaker}: VANDER thrashed me again today!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21154:
{speaker}: This is a distinguished place of
training for honorable trainers.
What is the meaning of this outrage? {speaker}: Those attackers...
How dare they attack others without
any regard for the rules?
They're failures as trainers! {speaker}: But anyway...
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21157:
{speaker}: Good, good!
Well done, you, a trainer whose heart
is just and pure! {speaker}: Stay on the path of the just and
good. {speaker}: But that's that, and this is this.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21161:
{speaker}: Ah, you two!
You've come for the MT. BATTLE
challenge?
Very impressive! {speaker}: But anyway...
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21253:
{speaker}: No!
I'm sorry, but I can't let you in.
It's full of thugs.
It's dangerous. {speaker}: Oh?
You heard about us from DUKING?
You must be here to save us! {speaker}: You see, it was me who contacted
DUKING for help.
I didn't think you would get here so
quickly.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21254:
{speaker}: Thank you!
You've freed MT. BATTLE from that
awful gang. {speaker}: We'll have to work hard to reopen
the facilities as soon as we can.
We can't hold up the training battles!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21255:
{speaker}: I'm sorry.
The trainers in the various ZONES
aren't ready yet. {speaker}: Please issue your challenge
a little bit later.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21256:
{speaker}: Thank you for waiting!
Training will resume on MT. BATTLE!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21257:
{speaker}: This is the MT. BATTLE registration.
Would you like to enter a knockout
challenge?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21258:
{speaker}: You'll enter?
Wonderful!
Please choose the POKéMON you
wish to enter.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21260:
{speaker}: Before starting your challenge,
I need to record your progress.
Would it be okay to save?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21262:
{speaker}: Would you like to start a new
challenge, or would you like to
resume an ongoing one?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21266:
{speaker}: I hope you do well on your knockout
challenge!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21294:
{speaker}: {player}, you have cleared up
to AREA {2f}. {speaker}: From which AREA would you like to
make your challenge?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21296:
{speaker}: Okay, you're making an entirely
new challenge.
I hope you do well in the knockout
battles!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21297:
{speaker}: Okay, you're making this challenge
from AREA {2f}.
Our ABRA will guide you there.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21299:
{speaker}: Okay, ABRA, do your thing.
I hope you do well in the knockout
battles!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21301:
{speaker}: Oh?
{player}, you haven't cleared any
AREAS yet. {speaker}: Would you like to make a brand-
new challenge?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21304:
{speaker}: MT. BATTLE is a place of training.
It consists of ten AREAS, each with
ten ZONES. {speaker}: In other words, there are one
hundred ZONES with a trainer in each.
You must battle through these AREAS
without taking a loss. {speaker}: By winning your way through
an AREA, you will be awarded POKé
COUPONS at a BREAK ROOM at the end. {speaker}: Every BREAK ROOM is outfitted with
a PC, so you may switch your party
POKéMON with those in storage. {speaker}: If you wish to quit or interrupt
your knockout challenge, you may
do so at any BREAK ROOM.
ABRA will TELEPORT you back here. {speaker}: Once you have won through an
AREA, you may resume your challenge
from the next AREA, or from any AREA
that you have cleared. {speaker}: For information about
POKé COUPONS, please ask at the
next counter.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21307: {speaker}: We hope to see you again!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21310:
{speaker}: Thank you for taking the MT. BATTLE
challenge!
Please come back for more training!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21313:
{speaker}: Thank you for taking the MT. BATTLE
challenge!
Better luck next time!
Please come back for more training!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21324:
{partner}: B-But...
Are you certain?
May we really have something this
precious?
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21357:
VANDER: But here, I want you to have
this.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21359:
VANDER: Of course you may.
I'd rather have you use that TIME
FLUTE than have those crooks take
it by force. VANDER: Use it, and save the
SHADOW POKéMON from their sinister
plans.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21360:
VANDER: By the way, you two seem to
have been fighting that gang for a
long time. VANDER: You should come here
for training, then.
It will toughen you up much, much
more. VANDER: I have to warn you, though.
If you come up against me, I won't
ease up one bit.
I'll be waiting!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21368:
{speaker}: Whatever the situation, I won't
abandon my duties.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21371:
{speaker}: It was terrifying, but I always
believed that we'd be saved. {speaker}: Anyways, I shouldn't be chatting.
I have my job to do!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21554:
{speaker}: It looks like they're after
VANDER, who's an AREA LEADER.
But why would anyone want to do
that? {speaker}: I'd go help, but the best I've ever
managed is eight consecutive wins.
I wouldn't get very far...
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21555:
{speaker}: Okay!
When training is resumed, I'm going
to aim to beat nine trainers in
a row. {speaker}: I doubt that I'd go farther since
the tenth trainer is VANDER.
Ehehe.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21556:
{speaker}: They reopened MT. BATTLE for
battle challenges.
But I'm too nervous and jumpy to
make a challenge.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.21689:
{speaker}: But please be careful.
The power of their POKéMON isn't
normal.
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.23480:
{speaker}: This is the COUPON EXCHANGE.
But right now, everything is suspended
because of those horrible people!
D2_pc_1F/D2_pc_1F.23481:
{speaker}: Thank you!
You saved VANDER, didn't you? {speaker}: When training is resumed on MT.
BATTLE, I'll be busy exchanging POKé
COUPONS.
I'd better be ready!
